hand_to_hand_combat.name: Hand-to-Hand Combat
hand_to_hand_combat.definition: Learned capacity to apply unarmed striking, grappling, control, escape, and defensive movement in explicitly represented close-combat or training contexts.
scope_excludes: physical attributes as substitutes for learned combat skill

knowledge_requirements.description: Distance, timing, balance, defense, and safe striking principles.
Position, leverage, control, escape, and safe close-contact principles.
Represented injury, escalation, and safe-practice boundaries.

applications.name: Engage in Unarmed Striking
applications.description: Apply represented unarmed striking and defensive movement against a represented opponent or training target.
applications.outcome_intent: Produce bounded striking and defensive performance rather than generic athletic movement.

failure_modes: loss of balance or defensive position
risk.consequence_bounds: Only explicitly represented unarmed-combat outcomes are affected. Skill score alone never authorizes harmful conduct or bypasses task safety and consequence rules.
risk.practice_reliability_boundary: Practice or simulation evidence does not automatically prove reliable consequential real-context performance.

applications.name: Control or Escape an Unarmed Grapple
applications.description: Apply represented grappling, positional control, escape, and close-contact defensive skill.
applications.outcome_intent: Gain, maintain, reverse, or escape a represented close-contact position within bounded task rules.

risk.consequence_bounds: Only explicitly represented grappling and control outcomes are affected; physical consequences remain owned by the represented task and safety systems.
risk.practice_reliability_boundary: Practice or simulation evidence does not automatically prove reliable consequential real-context performance.

E.summary: Can follow simple guided unarmed-combat drills.
E.limits: Independent unfamiliar combat is outside reliable capability.

D.summary: Can perform familiar routine unarmed techniques with limited independence.

C.summary: Can independently perform standard familiar striking and grappling tasks.

B.summary: Can combine established unarmed techniques in moderately complex represented exchanges.
B.independence: independent on ordinary and moderately complex tasks
B.limits: Advanced unfamiliar or consequential contexts may require support.

A.summary: Can adapt established unarmed methods across complex known represented exchanges.
A.limits: Extreme novelty or consequence remains task-bounded.

S.summary: Can consistently handle subtle advanced unarmed exchanges and select efficient responses.
S.limits: Extreme or high-consequence work is never authorized by score alone.

learning_evidence.notes: Existing structured Training Method evidence remains progression authority. Generic use, inspect, research, monitor, object names, and model prose are never implicit learning evidence.

presentation.short_description: Applied proficiency in represented unarmed striking and grappling.

provenance.historical_evidence_policy: Existing Hand-to-Hand score, experience, and already-consumed legitimate training evidence remain authoritative; generic historical actions are not reinterpreted.
provenance.migration_notes: Definition-only refactor. Existing parent Skill score is preserved and is not copied into striking or grappling child scores.

weapons.name: Weapons
weapons.definition: Learned capacity to safely handle and effectively employ familiar represented weapons within explicitly bounded melee or ranged task contexts.
scope_includes: safe handling within authored task constraints
scope_excludes: automatic mastery of every weapon family

knowledge_requirements.description: Safe handling, readiness, and control principles for familiar represented weapons.
Distance, timing, and control principles for familiar represented melee weapons.
Safe aiming, control, and established employment principles for familiar represented ranged weapons.

applications.name: Employ a Familiar Melee Weapon
applications.description: Use a represented familiar melee weapon inside an explicitly authored training, simulation, or bounded operational task.
applications.outcome_intent: Apply safe and effective familiar-melee handling within represented objective and consequence limits.

risk.consequence_bounds: Weapons score never independently authorizes consequential use. The represented task must separately own safety, target/context, weapon availability, and consequence rules.
risk.practice_reliability_boundary: Practice or simulation evidence does not automatically establish reliable consequential weapon performance.

applications.name: Employ a Familiar Ranged Weapon
applications.description: Use a represented familiar ranged weapon inside an explicitly authored training, simulation, or bounded operational task.
applications.outcome_intent: Apply safe and effective familiar-ranged handling within represented objective and consequence limits.

risk.consequence_bounds: Weapons score never independently authorizes consequential ranged use. The represented task must separately own safety, target/context, weapon availability, and consequence rules.
risk.practice_reliability_boundary: Practice or simulation evidence does not automatically establish reliable consequential weapon performance.

E.summary: Can follow guided safe handling on a simple familiar weapon.
E.limits: Independent employment is outside reliable capability.

D.summary: Can perform familiar routine weapon handling with limited independence.
D.limits: Complex or unfamiliar employment needs support.

C.summary: Can independently perform standard familiar weapon tasks in ordinary bounded contexts.
C.limits: Challenging or unfamiliar contexts need support.

B.summary: Can adapt established familiar-weapon methods to moderately complex represented situations.
B.independence: independent on ordinary and moderately complex tasks
B.limits: Advanced unfamiliar or consequential contexts may need specialist support.

A.summary: Can independently handle complex known familiar-weapon tasks under nontrivial uncertainty.

S.summary: Can consistently handle advanced familiar-weapon tasks and select efficient established responses.
S.limits: Extreme novelty or consequence is never authorized by score alone.

learning_evidence.notes: No Weapons learning producer is activated by this definition. Generic use, inspect, research, monitor, object names, and model prose are never implicit learning evidence.

presentation.short_description: Applied proficiency with familiar represented melee and ranged weapons.

provenance.historical_evidence_policy: Existing Weapons score remains authoritative; this definition does not invent or reinterpret historical progression evidence.
provenance.migration_notes: Definition-only refactor. Existing parent score is preserved and is not copied into melee or ranged child scores.

survival.name: Survival
survival.definition: Learned capacity to navigate, sustain oneself, and manage ordinary field-environment demands using represented information, materials, and established fieldcraft procedures.
scope_excludes: extreme expedition capability inferred from score alone

knowledge_requirements.description: Orientation, route selection, terrain interpretation, and correction principles.
Shelter, resource organization, exposure management, and bounded sustainment principles.
Recognition of represented environmental hazards and escalation boundaries.

applications.name: Navigate a Field Environment
applications.description: Determine and execute a route toward a represented field objective using terrain cues and optional navigation aids.
applications.outcome_intent: Progress toward the represented objective while managing route uncertainty and ordinary environmental constraints.

risk.consequence_bounds: Survival proficiency affects represented navigation only. Extreme environments or severe hazards require explicit task definitions, resources, safeguards, and reliability evidence.
risk.practice_reliability_boundary: Practice or simulation evidence does not automatically establish reliable high-risk field performance.

applications.name: Establish Field Sustainment
applications.description: Organize represented materials and established fieldcraft procedures to meet a bounded shelter, exposure, or sustainment need.
applications.outcome_intent: Create or maintain a represented sustainment state using explicit available materials.

risk.consequence_bounds: This application is bounded to explicitly represented materials, needs, and environment; high-hazard survival scenarios require separate safeguards.
risk.practice_reliability_boundary: Practice or simulation evidence does not automatically establish reliable high-risk field performance.

E.summary: Can follow simple guided fieldcraft steps.
E.limits: Independent unfamiliar field problems are outside reliable capability.

D.summary: Can perform familiar routine fieldcraft with limited independence.

C.summary: Can independently handle standard familiar navigation and sustainment tasks.

B.summary: Can adapt established fieldcraft to moderately complex represented conditions.
B.independence: independent on ordinary and moderately complex tasks
B.limits: Advanced unfamiliar or hazardous conditions may require specialist support.

A.summary: Can independently manage complex known fieldcraft tasks under nontrivial uncertainty.

S.summary: Can consistently solve subtle advanced represented fieldcraft problems using efficient established strategies.
S.limits: Extreme environments are never authorized by score alone.

learning_evidence.notes: No Survival learning producer is activated by this definition. Generic use, inspect, research, monitor, object names, and model prose are never implicit learning evidence.

presentation.short_description: Applied field navigation and sustainment proficiency.

provenance.historical_evidence_policy: Existing Survival score remains authoritative; this definition does not invent or reinterpret historical progression evidence.
provenance.migration_notes: Definition-only refactor. Existing parent score is preserved and is not copied into navigation or sustainment child scores.

tactical_planning.name: Tactical Planning
tactical_planning.definition: Learned capacity to assess represented tactical situations, organize available information, and develop bounded maneuver or contingency plans toward an explicit objective.

knowledge_requirements.description: Identify objectives, constraints, threats, opportunities, and information gaps.
Sequence movement, positioning, timing, and resource use toward a tactical objective.
Identify plausible branches, failure points, and bounded fallback options.

applications.name: Assess a Tactical Situation
applications.description: Analyze represented tactical information and an explicit objective to identify constraints, threats, opportunities, and information gaps.
applications.outcome_intent: Produce a bounded assessment grounded only in represented information.

risk.consequence_bounds: This application can reason only over represented information. Skill score does not create hidden intelligence, command authority, or guaranteed operational outcomes.
risk.practice_reliability_boundary: Simulation planning evidence does not automatically prove reliable consequential operational performance.

applications.name: Plan a Tactical Maneuver or Contingency
applications.description: Develop a represented maneuver, sequence, or contingency plan toward an explicit tactical objective.
applications.outcome_intent: Produce a coherent bounded plan and fallback structure without directly resolving execution outcomes.

risk.consequence_bounds: Planning quality is distinct from action execution. World and action engines own movement, combat, resources, and consequences; Tactical Planning never guarantees them.
risk.practice_reliability_boundary: Simulation planning evidence does not automatically prove reliable consequential operational performance.

E.summary: Can follow a guided assessment or simple tactical plan.
E.limits: Independent ambiguous planning is outside reliable capability.

D.summary: Can handle familiar routine tactical assessments with limited independence.

C.summary: Can independently assess and plan standard familiar represented tactical situations.

B.summary: Can integrate several represented factors and adapt established plans to moderately complex situations.
B.independence: independent on ordinary and moderately complex tasks
B.limits: Advanced unfamiliar situations may require specialist input.

A.summary: Can independently assess complex known tactical situations and build robust bounded contingencies.
A.limits: Extreme novelty or consequence remains task-bounded.

S.summary: Can consistently isolate subtle tactical factors and produce efficient advanced plans under represented uncertainty.
S.limits: Extreme or high-consequence planning is never authorized by score alone.

learning_evidence.notes: Existing VR Tactical Drills and AI Combat Simulation progression evidence remain authoritative. Generic use, inspect, research, monitor, object names, and model prose are never implicit learning evidence.

presentation.short_description: Applied tactical assessment, maneuver, and contingency planning proficiency.

provenance.historical_evidence_policy: Existing Tactical Planning score, experience, and already-consumed legitimate training evidence remain authoritative; generic historical actions are not reinterpreted.
provenance.migration_notes: Definition-only refactor. Existing parent Skill score is preserved and is not copied into assessment or maneuver child scores.

technology.name: Technology
technology.definition: Learned capacity to understand, configure, diagnose, maintain, and troubleshoot designed technical systems by applying relevant knowledge, tools, documentation, and safe procedures.
scope_excludes: research-grade design without explicit task support

knowledge_requirements.description: Components, interfaces, states, inputs, outputs, and common failure patterns.
Safe ordered diagnostic and troubleshooting procedures.
Interpretation of represented manuals, logs, status codes, diagrams, and feedback.

applications.name: Diagnose Known System Fault
applications.description: Inspect represented symptoms, logs, telemetry, and diagnostic feedback to identify a likely fault source and safe next step for a known technical system family.
applications.outcome_intent: Produce a justified fault assessment and next-step recommendation rather than merely operate the system.
required_context: represented technical system with diagnostic evidence

risk.consequence_bounds: Technology may influence represented diagnostics only. High-risk live systems require explicit task definitions, resources, knowledge, safeguards, and reliability evidence; score alone never authorizes them.
risk.practice_reliability_boundary: Simulation or purpose-built practice demonstrates learning, not automatic reliability in consequential live systems.

E.summary: Can follow explicit guided steps on simple familiar technical systems.
E.limits: Independent meaningful diagnosis is outside reliable capability.

D.summary: Can perform simple routine checks and obvious fault identification with guidance.

C.summary: Can independently perform standard diagnostics on familiar systems.

B.summary: Can combine evidence and adapt established diagnostic procedures to moderately complex cases.
B.independence: independent on ordinary and moderately complex known work
B.limits: Advanced unfamiliar or consequential systems may require specialist support.

A.summary: Can independently diagnose complex but known systems under nontrivial uncertainty.
A.limits: Research novelty or high consequence remains task-bounded.

S.summary: Can consistently isolate subtle multi-factor faults in advanced known or adjacent systems.
S.limits: Extreme novelty or high consequence is never authorized by score alone.

learning_evidence.notes: Generic use, inspect, research, monitor, object names, and model prose are never Technology learning evidence by implication.

presentation.short_description: Applied proficiency with represented technical systems and diagnostics.

provenance.historical_evidence_policy: Existing Technology score, experience, and already-consumed Systems Diagnostic Practice evidence remain authoritative; generic historical actions are not reinterpreted.
provenance.migration_notes: v1.2 makes required-resource mode explicit without changing actor state or historical learning evidence.

field_medicine.name: Field Medicine
field_medicine.definition: Learned capacity to assess represented casualties and perform bounded field stabilization or evacuation preparation within explicit medical-task, resource, and safety constraints.
scope_excludes: real-world medical authority from gameplay score

knowledge_requirements.description: Structured field assessment, prioritization, and recognition of represented urgent problems.
Bounded represented stabilization and prevention-of-deterioration principles pending escalation.
Represented preparation, communication, and handoff principles for evacuation or higher-level care.

applications.name: Assess a Field Casualty
applications.description: Perform a structured assessment of a represented casualty inside an authored field-medical scenario.
applications.outcome_intent: Identify represented priority concerns and an escalation or next-step category without implying definitive diagnosis.

risk.consequence_bounds: These are simulation and gameplay semantics, not medical advice or real-world authorization. Consequential medical tasks require explicit represented patient state, safeguards, resources, and bounded procedure contracts.
risk.practice_reliability_boundary: Practice or simulation evidence does not automatically establish real-world medical competence or authorization.

applications.name: Stabilize for Evacuation or Handoff
applications.description: Apply a bounded represented stabilization and evacuation-preparation task using explicit supplies and authored casualty state.
applications.outcome_intent: Reduce represented immediate deterioration risk and prepare escalation or handoff without implying definitive treatment.

risk.consequence_bounds: These are simulation and gameplay semantics, not medical advice or real-world authorization. High-consequence treatment remains outside generic Field Medicine authority unless an explicit represented task owns patient state, procedure, tools, safeguards, and outcomes.
risk.practice_reliability_boundary: Practice or simulation evidence does not automatically establish real-world medical competence or authorization.

E.summary: Can follow simple guided field-casualty assessment steps.
E.limits: Independent medical judgment is outside reliable capability.

D.summary: Can perform familiar routine field-medical steps with limited independence.

C.summary: Can independently perform standard familiar field assessment and bounded stabilization tasks.
C.limits: Challenging or ambiguous cases require escalation.

B.summary: Can combine represented findings and adapt established field-medical procedures to moderately complex cases.
B.independence: independent on ordinary and moderately complex tasks
B.limits: Advanced or consequential cases may require higher-level support.

A.summary: Can independently manage complex known field-medical assessment and bounded stabilization under uncertainty.
A.independence: high independence within represented known scope
A.limits: Definitive or high-consequence treatment remains task-bounded.

S.summary: Can consistently identify subtle represented priorities and select efficient bounded field stabilization strategies.
S.limits: Extreme or definitive medical work is never authorized by score alone.

learning_evidence.notes: No Field Medicine learning producer is activated by this definition. Generic use, inspect, research, monitor, object names, and model prose are never implicit learning evidence.

presentation.short_description: Bounded represented field-casualty assessment and stabilization proficiency.

provenance.historical_evidence_policy: Existing Field Medicine score remains authoritative; this definition does not invent or reinterpret historical progression evidence.
provenance.migration_notes: Definition-only refactor. Existing parent score is preserved and is not copied into assessment or stabilization child scores.
